facility_chart_instructions: Treat all patients with serum paracetamol levels above the nomogram treatment line.

A single nomogram treatment line is recommended. This line has been lowered by 25% from standard lines to allow for potential error estimating the time of ingestion and increased safety for patients with potential risk factors.
Ensure that the correct units are used: µmol/L or mg/L.
